tools.name: recall
tools.description: Return every piece of evidence in scope for `topic` (decisions + graph triples + community summaries).

tools.name: scoped_search
tools.description: Like recall, but ranks evidence against `query` and returns the top N hits.

tools.name: ask
tools.description: Ask the company's DecisionGraph a natural-language question. Runs the host-side ReAct loop (THINK/ACT/ANSWER) using the company's LLM gateway against ONLY the scoped slice. Returns a multi-paragraph, graph-grounded answer with reasoning.

tools.name: done
tools.description: Signal job completion. Pass your final `answer` and an optional `citation`. After this the sandbox exits.

tools.name: ingest_pdf
tools.description: Ingest a PDF (server-local path) into the personal graph.

tools.name: ingest_url
tools.description: Queue async ingest of a web URL. Returns a job_id; poll job_status.

tools.name: ingest_youtube
tools.description: Queue async ingest of a YouTube transcript. Returns a job_id.

tools.name: ingest_media
tools.description: Queue async transcription of an audio/video file.

tools.name: job_status
tools.description: Poll a background job (ingest/dream).

tools.name: update_files
tools.description: Incrementally update the code graph after editing files — INSTANT, no clone. files=[{path, text}]. Call right after writing code (NOT ingest_github).

tools.name: find_callers
tools.description: Who calls a function/class? Structural, instant.

tools.name: blast_radius
tools.description: What files break if this file/symbol changes? Structural.

tools.name: triage_pr
tools.description: Risk-score a set of changed files (0-100) + merge hint.

tools.name: topology
tools.description: God-nodes, surprising connections, orphans, deep inheritance.

tools.name: code_graph_stats
tools.description: Counts in the structural code graph.

tools.name: rationales
tools.description: Surface # WHY:/# HACK:/# SAFETY: rationales near a symbol/file.

tools.name: semantic_stale
tools.description: Files edited since last semantic pass (pending refresh).

tools.name: post_message
tools.description: Post a message to a specific peer (by role name) or 'all'. Active inside an orchestration dialog run only.

tools.name: read_messages
tools.description: Read recent dialog messages addressed to you or broadcast in the current run.

tools.name: wait_for_message
tools.description: Block until a new dialog message arrives or timeout (max 120s).

tools.name: register_peer_tool
tools.description: Declare a tool YOU provide for peers in this orchestration run. Other agents will see it in list_peer_tools and can call it via call_peer_tool.

tools.name: list_peer_tools
tools.description: List tools other agents in this run have exposed.

tools.name: call_peer_tool
tools.description: Call a tool exposed by a peer agent in this run. Returns its result via the message bus; same scope+audit guarantees.

tools.name: list_peers
tools.description: List other agents in the current orchestration run.

tools.name: ingest_github
tools.description: Ingest a public github.com URL into the user's DG. Full 6-layer pipeline: docs+commits+manifests, tree-sitter AST chunks summarised per function/class, folder/repo rollups, call-graph edges, recent PRs, incremental hash cache. Call this BEFORE editing an unfamiliar repo so the agent has full context.

tools.name: ingest_repo
tools.description: Ingest a local git repo (READMEs, ADRs, manifests, CODEOWNERS, module docstrings, recent commits) into the DG memory. Stores each artifact as a [repo:<name>] decision.

tools.name: get_codebase_context
tools.description: Get the most relevant DG decisions for a file/intent the user is currently editing. Call this BEFORE answering coding questions so the answer is grounded in project history. Returns hits + a ready-to-paste system-prompt context block.

tools.name: track_code_edit
tools.description: Record an edit you (the agent) just made to a file. Pass before+after text — the platform computes a unified diff and stores it as a permanent decision in the user's DG, tagged with WHO did it, WHEN, WHERE in the file, WHY (your reasoning + the user's prompt). Call this after every meaningful code change so future sessions can audit why each modification happened.

tools.name: track_decision
tools.description: Record an arbitrary decision you made that did NOT involve a code edit (e.g. 'I decided to use Postgres because X'). Becomes a permanent decision node in the user's DG.

tools.name: recent_code_edits
tools.description: Return the N most recent AI-driven code edits captured in this workspace. Useful for audit, change history, and giving the next agent context about what's been touched lately.

tools.name: forecast
tools.description: Forecast a univariate time series. Returns point + 95% lower/upper, plus which backend was used (TimesFM if installed, else Holt-Winters, else linear). Pair with simulate/ask for quant+qualitative decision analysis.

tools.name: forecast_backend_info
tools.description: Which forecasting backend is active right now.

tools.name: run_python
tools.description: Execute Python in an ephemeral, network-less sub-sandbox. Returns stdout, stderr, exit code. Useful for calculations, data wrangling, formatting, ad-hoc logic.

tools.name: get_graph
tools.description: Return the knowledge graph (nodes + edges) for this workspace.

tools.name: list_companies
tools.description: List companies in this workspace.

tools.name: create_company
tools.description: Create a new company.

tools.name: ingest_company_document
tools.description: Ingest a document into a specific company.

tools.name: list_company_docs
tools.description: List documents ingested into a company.

tools.name: query
tools.description: Query the DG. mode=auto routes by intent (normal/session/deep).

tools.name: start_session
tools.description: Start a discussion session.

tools.name: send_message
tools.description: Send a message into a discussion session.

tools.name: end_session
tools.description: End a discussion session (folds it into graph memory).

tools.name: list_sessions
tools.description: List all discussion sessions in this workspace.

tools.name: get_compiled
tools.description: Get Compiled Truth for a community or all communities.

tools.name: get_timeline
tools.description: Get the immutable timeline for a topic.

tools.name: recall_entity
tools.description: Recall everything we know about an entity.

tools.name: run_dream_cycle
tools.description: Queue a Dream Cycle (decay/dedupe/relink/compile). Returns job_id.

tools.name: export_workspace
tools.description: Export this workspace's decisions and stats.

tools.name: mark_outcome
tools.description: Mark the outcome of a past decision.

tools.name: supersede
tools.description: Mark one decision as superseded by another.

tools.name: get_decision_chain
tools.description: Get the causal chain for a decision.

tools.name: decay
tools.description: Run confidence decay on aged decisions.

tools.name: start_simulation
tools.description: Start a scenario simulation. Returns sim_id.

tools.name: get_simulation
tools.description: Get a simulation's current state/result.

tools.name: list_simulations
tools.description: List simulations in this workspace.

tools.name: store_simulation
tools.description: Persist a simulation result into the graph.
